diagnostics.message: The explicit depends_on of :resource.google_dns_record_set.dns_record_set on :resource.google_dns_managed_zone.dns_managed_zone is redundant: the record set's `name` attribute uses `each.value.resource_name`, computed in `local.recordsets` from `local.managed_zone.dns_name`, which already references `google_dns_managed_zone.dns_managed_zone[0]`. Terraform therefore infers the record-set-after-zone ordering implicitly (and when `var.zone_config == null` the same local pulls in `data.google_dns_managed_zone.dns_managed_zone` instead), so the bare `depends_on` adds no ordering Terraform doesn't already derive.
